data.command: What security tools do you have deployed?

data.text:
We've got a robust set of security tools deployed on this Ubuntu 22.04.3 LTS server, running on kernel 5.15.0-91. Let me give you a rundown.

**Intrusion Detection and Prevention Systems:**
We're running Suricata IDS (Version 6.0.8) on port 514, with a configuration file at `/etc/suricata/suricata.yaml`. It's configured to monitor incoming traffic on all interfaces and alert on known exploit and malware signatures.

**Firewall:**
The Uncomplicated Firewall (UFW) is enabled and configured to allow incoming traffic on SSH (port 22), HTTP (port 80), and HTTPS (port 443), and deny all other incoming traffic by default. The UFW configuration file is located at `/etc/ufw/ufw.conf`.

**File System Monitoring:**
Auditor ( Version 2.7.1) is running in the background, monitoring file system integrity and alerting on any changes to critical files and directories, including `/etc/passwd`, `/etc/group`, and `/boot`.

**Network Monitoring:**
We've got Nagios (Version 4.4.5) set up to monitor network services,
